title: Native inverse projection naturality and unit normalization
statement: For the actual fg operations at either native finite-coefficient site [def-pur-composite-integration-operations], inverse projection satisfies F(L tensor P h) followed by q(L,K prime) = q(L,K) followed by F L tensor h whenever the two components are invertible. At the tensor unit, F(twistUnit inverse) followed by F(beta(P1,L)) and q(L,1) equals the inverse right unitor of F L whenever that component is invertible. These assertions hold for every L and arrow h, independently of the supplied twisted adjunctions, and are exactly IntegrationProjectionLaws for the selected native composite operation.

proof.text: Specialize the actual projection natural transformation to fixed L and h. Multiply its naturality square by the two component inverses to obtain the inverse square. Only those two components must be invertible.

proof.text: Expand the native compactification projection. Right unitality of the proper counit mate follows from monoidal unitality and the adjunction triangle. Cancel the unit comparisons of the open tensor map and pullback compositor. Invert this right-unit identity; braiding-unit compatibility identifies its source map with inverse twistUnit followed by beta. The ordinary site also has Etale.projectionMap_rightUnitality. Apply the identical counit/open construction at the pro-etale site.
